calls.title: GrowthBook <> Brightscout: Check-in
calls.summary: The team discussed critical updates necessary for the website ahead of the product launch scheduled for next Wednesday. Ljubomir approved publishing updated content before launch, and Karen planned immediate updates while holding further changes for post-launch. A redirect issue on the GrowthBook domain was identified, and DNS adjustments were assigned for implementation. Performance monitoring will occur with weekly checks post-launch, while thorough documentation and knowledge transfer sessions were scheduled for technical and marketing staff. The team is also working on outstanding bug fixes, particularly for compare pages and alt text issues, to improve user experience and address SEO concerns. Enhanced communication practices were agreed upon to manage task timelines effectively and maintain team alignment.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Webflow, DNS Redirects, Documentation Handover, SEO Alt Text, Website Performance
